name: Morningdew Farms
source: Sweet southern boy Cody always dreamed of living off the land.  Now he's inherited his granddaddy's old farm and can begin a wonderful new life in the village of Morningdew--a notorious Gayborhood!
translation: 可爱的南方男孩科迪一直梦想着在这片土地上生活。现在他继承了祖父的老农场，可以在晨露村开始美好的新生活——一个臭名昭著的同性恋社区！
